# StructuralPriorEncoding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The integration of explicit topological or geometric structure (e.g., adjacency matrices, spatial coordinates) into attention weight computation for spiking neural networks. Bridges TCC's topology-centric design with iNEST's neuromorphic constraints, enabling better inductive biases for spatially organized spike streams.
